assignments.name: mensagem_4

parameters.query:
SELECT csl.call_id, csl.changed_at, cp.mailing_id
FROM calls_status_log csl
INNER JOIN calls_pipeline cp ON cp.id = csl.call_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT call_id, MAX(changed_at) AS changed_at
    FROM calls_status_log
    WHERE to_status = 'grupo_criado'
    GROUP BY call_id
) latest ON latest.call_id = csl.call_id AND latest.changed_at = csl.changed_at
WHERE csl.to_status = 'grupo_criado'

SELECT id AS call_id, dt_call, mailing_id
FROM calls_pipeline
WHERE dt_call IS NOT NULL
